arguments.Code: using UnityEngine; using UnityEngine.UI; using InhaExpress.Client.Presentation; using InhaExpress.Client.MapClient; internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand { public void Execute(ExecutionResult result) { var c=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<UnityAutonomousClient>(); var hud=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<WebClientHud>(); var map=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<CampusServerMap>(); var v=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<VehicleController>(); if(c==null||!c.Connected||hud==null||v==null||string.IsNullOrEmpty(map?.RunId)){result.Log("NOT_READY");return;} if(map.LatestState.requests!=null&&map.LatestState.requests.Length>0){result.Log("REQUEST_EXISTS");return;} foreach(var d in Object.FindObjectsByType<Dropdown>(FindObjectsSortMode.None)) { string wanted=d.name=="Request Pickup"?"60주년":d.name=="Request Dropoff"?"비룡플라자":null; if(wanted==null)continue; int index=d.options.FindIndex(o=>o.text==wanted); if(index<1){result.Log("MISSING_OPTION "+wanted);return;} d.value=index; } hud.OperatorControls.SelectVehicle("V01"); Camera cam=null; foreach(var candidate in Object.FindObjectsByType<Camera>(FindObjectsSortMode.None))if(candidate.enabled&&candidate.targetTexture==null)cam=candidate; var rec=v.gameObject.AddComponent<CampusDriveTelemetry>(); rec.Begin(v,c,cam,"artifacts/high_speed_drive/heading-turn-anniversary-biryong.csv",900); foreach(var b in Object.FindObjectsByType<Button>(FindObjectsSortMode.None)) if(b.transform.parent.name=="Submit Request"){b.onClick.Invoke();result.Log("SUBMITTED run="+map.RunId);return;} result.Log("NO_SUBMIT_BUTTON"); } }
